1.english_reference: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲזַרְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן עוֹדֵ֔ד הָיְתָ֥ה עָלָ֖י ו ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.LXX: Καὶ Ἀζαρίας υἱὸς Ὠδήδ , ἐγένετο ἐπ᾽ αὐτὸν πνεῦμα Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: Azarías autem fílius Oded , facto in se spíritu Dei ,
traditions.KJV: And the Spirit of God came upon Azariah the son of Oded :

2.english_reference: And he went out to meet Asa

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּצֵא֮ לִ פְנֵ֣י אָסָא֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ἀπάντησιν αὐτῶν ἐν παντὶ Ἰούδᾳ καὶ Βενιαμείν ,
traditions.VUL: egréssus est in occúrsum Asa ,
traditions.KJV: And he went out to meet Asa ,

2.english_reference: and said unto him , Hear ye me , Asa , and all Judah and Benjamin

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔ וֹ שְׁמָע֕וּ נִי אָסָ֖א וְ כָל יְהוּדָ֣ה וּ בִנְיָמִ֑ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν
traditions.VUL: et dixit ei : Audíte me Asa , et omnis Iuda et Béniamin :
traditions.KJV: and said unto him , Hear ye me , Asa , and all Judah and Benjamin ;

2.english_reference: The LORD [ is ] with you , while ye be with him

traditions.WLC: יְהוָ֤ה עִמָּ כֶם֙ בִּֽ הְיֽוֹתְ כֶ֣ם עִמּ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Κύριος μεθ᾽ ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ εἶναι ἡμᾶς μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ ·
traditions.VUL: Dóminus vobíscum , quia fuístis cum eo .
traditions.KJV: The LORD [ is ] with you , while ye be with him ;

2.english_reference: and if ye seek him , he will be found of you

traditions.WLC: וְ אִֽם תִּדְרְשֻׁ֨ הוּ֙ יִמָּצֵ֣א לָ כֶ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐὰν ἐκζητήσητε αὐτόν , εὑρεθήσεται ὑμῖν ·
traditions.VUL: Si quæsiéritis eum , inveniétis :
traditions.KJV: and if ye seek him , he will be found of you ;

2.english_reference: but if ye forsake him , he will forsake you

traditions.WLC: וְ אִם תַּעַזְבֻ֖ הוּ יַעֲזֹ֥ב אֶתְ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐὰν καταλίπητε αὐτόν , ἐνκαταλείψει ὑμᾶς .
traditions.VUL: si autem dereliquéritis eum , derelínquet vos .
traditions.KJV: but if ye forsake him , he will forsake you .

3.english_reference: Now for a long season Israel [ hath been ] without the true God

traditions.WLC: וְ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים לְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ לֹ֣א אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֱמֶ֗ת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἡμέραι πολλαὶ τῷ Ἰσραὴλ ἐν οὐ θεῷ ἀληθινῷ
traditions.VUL: Transíbunt autem multi dies in Israel absque Deo vero ,
traditions.KJV: Now for a long season Israel [ hath been ] without the true God ,

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ לֹ֛א כֹּהֵ֥ן מוֹרֶ֖ה
traditions.VUL: et absque sacerdóte doctóre ,
traditions.KJV: and without a teaching priest ,

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ לֹ֥א תוֹרָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν οὐ νόμῳ .
traditions.VUL: et absque lege .
traditions.KJV: and without law .

4.english_reference: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨שָׁב֙ בַּ צַּר ל֔ וֹ עַל יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπιστρέψει αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ Κύριον θεὸν Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Cumque revérsi fúerint in angústia sua ad Dóminum Deum Israel ,
traditions.KJV: But when they in their trouble did turn unto the LORD God of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְבַקְשֻׁ֖ הוּ
traditions.VUL: et quæsíerint eum ,
traditions.KJV: and sought him ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמָּצֵ֥א לָ הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὑρεθήσεται αὐτοῖς .
traditions.VUL: repérient eum .
traditions.KJV: he was found of them .

5.english_reference: And in those times [ there was ] no peace to him that went out , nor to him that came in

traditions.WLC: וּ בָ עִתִּ֣ים הָ הֵ֔ם אֵ֥ין שָׁל֖וֹם לַ יּוֹצֵ֣א וְ לַ בָּ֑א
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ οὐκ ἔστιν εἰρήνη τῷ εἰσπορευομένῳ καὶ τῷ ἐκπορευομένῳ ,
traditions.VUL: In témpore illo non erit pax egrediénti , et ingrediénti ,
traditions.KJV: And in those times [ there was ] no peace to him that went out , nor to him that came in ,

5.english_reference: but great vexations [ were ] upon all the inhabitants of the countries

traditions.WLC: כִּ֚י מְהוּמֹ֣ת רַבּ֔וֹת עַ֥ל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָ אֲרָצֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἔκστασις Κυρίου ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας χώρας .
traditions.VUL: sed terróres úndique in cunctis habitatóribus terrárum :
traditions.KJV: but great vexations [ were ] upon all the inhabitants of the countries .

6.english_reference: And nation was destroyed of nation , and city of city

traditions.WLC: וְ כֻתְּת֥וּ גוֹי בְּ ג֖וֹי וְ עִ֣יר בְּ עִ֑יר
traditions.LXX: καὶ πολεμήσει ἔθνος πρὸς ἔθνος καὶ πόλις πρὸς πόλιν ,
traditions.VUL: pugnábit enim gens contra gentem , et cívitas contra civitátem ,
traditions.KJV: And nation was destroyed of nation , and city of city :

6.english_reference: for God did vex them with all adversity

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי אֱלֹהִ֥ים הֲמָמָ֖ ם בְּ כָל צָרָֽה
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἐξέστησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν πάσῃ θλίψει .
traditions.VUL: quia Dóminus conturbábit eos in omni angústia .
traditions.KJV: for God did vex them with all adversity .

7.english_reference: Be ye strong therefore , and let not your hands be weak

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתֶּ֣ם חִזְק֔וּ וְ אַל יִרְפּ֖וּ יְדֵי כֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὑμεῖς ἰσχύσατε καὶ μὴ ἐκλυέσθωσαν αἱ χεῖρες ὑμῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Vos ergo confortámini , et non dissolvántur manus vestræ :
traditions.KJV: Be ye strong therefore , and let not your hands be weak :

7.english_reference: for your work shall be rewarded

traditions.WLC: כִּ֛י יֵ֥שׁ שָׂכָ֖ר לִ פְעֻלַּתְ כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἔστιν μισθὸς τῇ ἐργασίᾳ ὑμῶν .
traditions.VUL: erit enim merces óperi vestro .
traditions.KJV: for your work shall be rewarded .

8.english_reference: And when Asa heard these words , and the prophecy of Oded the prophet

traditions.WLC: וְ כִ שְׁמֹ֨עַ אָסָ֜א הַ דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ אֵ֗לֶּה וְ הַ נְּבוּאָה֮ עֹדֵ֣ד הַ נָּבִיא֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαι τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ τὴν προφητείαν Ἀδὰδ τοῦ προφήτου ,
traditions.VUL: Quod cum audísset Asa , verba scílicet , et prophetíam Azaríæ fílii Oded prophétæ ,
traditions.KJV: And when Asa heard these words , and the prophecy of Oded the prophet ,

traditions.WLC: הִתְחַזַּ֗ק
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατίσχυσεν
traditions.VUL: confortátus est ,
traditions.KJV: he took courage ,

8.english_reference: and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin , and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּעֲבֵ֤ר הַ שִּׁקּוּצִים֙ מִ כָּל אֶ֤רֶץ יְהוּדָה֙ וּ בִנְיָמִ֔ן וּ מִן הֶ֣ עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכַ֖ד מֵ הַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τὰ βδελύγματα ἀπὸ πάσης τῆς γῆς Ἰούδα καὶ Βενιαμεὶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πόλεων ὧν κατέσχεν ἐν ὄρει Ἐφράιμ ,
traditions.VUL: et ábstulit idóla de omni terra Iuda , et de Béniamin , et ex úrbibus , quas céperat , montis Ephraim :
traditions.KJV: and put away the abominable idols out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin , and out of the cities which he had taken from mount Ephraim ,

8.english_reference: and renewed the altar of the LORD , that [ was ] before the porch of the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יְחַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֕ר לִ פְנֵ֖י אוּלָ֥ם יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνεκαίνισεν τὸ θυσιαστήριον Κυρίου ὃ ἦν ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ ναοῦ Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: et dedicávit altáre Dómini quod erat ante pórticum Dómini .
traditions.KJV: and renewed the altar of the LORD , that [ was ] before the porch of the LORD .

9.english_reference: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin , and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh , and out of Simeon

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקְבֹּ֗ץ אֶת כָּל יְהוּדָה֙ וּ בִנְיָמִ֔ן וְ הַ גָּרִים֙ עִמָּ הֶ֔ם מֵ אֶפְרַ֥יִם וּ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וּ מִ שִּׁמְע֑וֹן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐξεκκλησίασεν τὸν Ἰούδαν καὶ Βενιαμεὶν καὶ τοὺς προσηλύτους τοὺς παροικοῦντας μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ Ἐφράιμ καὶ ἀπὸ Μανασσὴ καὶ ἀπὸ Συμεών ,
traditions.VUL: Congregavítque univérsum Iudam et Béniamin , et ádvenas cum eis de Ephraim , et de Manásse , et de Símeon :
traditions.KJV: And he gathered all Judah and Benjamin , and the strangers with them out of Ephraim and Manasseh , and out of Simeon :

9.english_reference: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance , when they saw that the LORD his God [ was ] with him

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נָפְל֨וּ עָלָ֤י ו מִ יִּשְׂרָאֵל֙ לָ רֹ֔ב בִּ רְאֹתָ֕ ם כִּֽי יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָ֖י ו עִמּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι προσετέθησαν πρὸς αὐτὸν πολλοὶ τοῦ Ἰσραὴλ ἐν τῷ ἰδεῖν αὐτοὺς ὅτι Κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτοῦ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: plures enim ad eum confúgerant ex Israel , vidéntes quod Dóminus Deus illíus esset cum eo .
traditions.KJV: for they fell to him out of Israel in abundance , when they saw that the LORD his God [ was ] with him .

10.english_reference: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקָּבְצ֥וּ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνήχθησαν εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ
traditions.VUL: Cumque veníssent in Ierúsalem
traditions.KJV: So they gathered themselves together at Jerusalem

10.english_reference: in the third month , in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa

traditions.WLC: בַּ חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ שְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לִ שְׁנַ֥ת חֲמֵשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה לְ מַלְכ֥וּת אָסָֽא
traditions.LXX: ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ τρίτῳ ἐν τῷ πεντεκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας Ἀσά .
traditions.VUL: mense tértio , anno decimoquínto regni Asa ,
traditions.KJV: in the third month , in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa .

11.english_reference: And they offered unto the LORD the same time

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּזְבְּח֤וּ לַ יהוָה֙ בַּ יּ֣וֹם הַ ה֔וּא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔθυσεν τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ
traditions.VUL: immolavérunt Dómino in die illa
traditions.KJV: And they offered unto the LORD the same time ,

11.english_reference: of the spoil [ which ] they had brought

traditions.WLC: מִן הַ שָּׁלָ֖ל הֵבִ֑יאוּ
traditions.LXX: ὧν ἤνεγκεν ,
traditions.VUL: de manúbiis , et præda , quam addúxerant ,
traditions.KJV: of the spoil [ which ] they had brought ,

11.english_reference: seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep

traditions.WLC: בָּקָר֙ שְׁבַ֣ע מֵא֔וֹת וְ צֹ֖אן שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִֽים
traditions.LXX: μόσχους ἑπτακοσίους καὶ πρόβατα ἑπτακισχίλια .
traditions.VUL: boves septingéntos , et aríetes septem míllia .
traditions.KJV: seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep .

12.english_reference: And they entered into a covenant

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּבֹ֣אוּ בַ בְּרִ֔ית
traditions.LXX: καὶ διῆλθεν ἐν διαθήκῃ
traditions.VUL: Et intrávit ex more ad corroborándum fœdus ,
traditions.KJV: And they entered into a covenant

12.english_reference: to seek the LORD God of their fathers

traditions.WLC: לִ דְר֕וֹשׁ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ζητῆσαι Κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν
traditions.VUL: ut quǽrerent Dóminum Deum patrum suórum
traditions.KJV: to seek the LORD God of their fathers

12.english_reference: with all their heart and with all their soul

traditions.WLC: בְּ כָל לְבָבָ֖ ם וּ בְ כָל נַפְשָֽׁ ם
traditions.LXX: ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς .
traditions.VUL: in toto corde , et in tota ánima sua .
traditions.KJV: with all their heart and with all their soul ;

13.english_reference: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel

traditions.WLC: וְ כֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יִדְרֹ֛שׁ לַ יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἐὰν μὴ ἐκζητήσῃ Κύριον θεὸν Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Si quis autem , inquit , non quæsíerit Dóminum Deum Israel ,
traditions.KJV: That whosoever would not seek the LORD God of Israel

traditions.WLC: יוּמָ֑ת
traditions.LXX: ἀποθανειται
traditions.VUL: moriátur ,
traditions.KJV: should be put to death ,

traditions.WLC: לְ מִן קָטֹן֙ וְ עַד גָּד֔וֹל
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ νεωτέρου ἕως πρεσβυτέρου ,
traditions.VUL: a mínimo usque ad máximum ,
traditions.KJV: whether small or great ,

traditions.WLC: לְ מֵ אִ֖ישׁ וְ עַד אִשָּֽׁה
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς ἕως γυναικός .
traditions.VUL: a viro usque ad mulíerem .
traditions.KJV: whether man or woman .

14.english_reference: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשָּֽׁבְעוּ֙ לַ יהוָ֔ה בְּ ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὤμοσαν ἐν Κυρίῳ ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ
traditions.VUL: Iuraverúntque Dómino voce magna
traditions.KJV: And they sware unto the LORD with a loud voice ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בִ תְרוּעָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: in iúbilo ,
traditions.KJV: and with shouting ,

14.english_reference: and with trumpets , and with cornets

traditions.WLC: וּ בַ חֲצֹצְר֖וֹת וּ בְ שׁוֹפָרֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν σάλπιγξιν .
traditions.VUL: et in clangóre tubæ , et in sónitu buccinárum ,
traditions.KJV: and with trumpets , and with cornets .

15.english_reference: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׂמְח֨וּ כָל יְהוּדָ֜ה עַל הַ שְּׁבוּעָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ηὐφράνθησαν πᾶς Ἰουδὰ περὶ τοῦ ὅρκου ,
traditions.VUL: omnes qui erant in Iuda , cum exsecratióne :
traditions.KJV: And all Judah rejoiced at the oath :

15.english_reference: for they had sworn with all their heart , and sought him with their whole desire

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י בְ כָל לְבָבָ ם֙ נִשְׁבָּ֔עוּ וּ בְ כָל רְצוֹנָ֣ ם בִּקְשֻׁ֔ הוּ
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς ὤμοσαν , ἐν πάσῃ θελήσει ἐζήτησαν αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: in omni enim corde suo iuravérunt , et in tota voluntáte quæsiérunt eum ,
traditions.KJV: for they had sworn with all their heart , and sought him with their whole desire ;

15.english_reference: and he was found of them

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמָּצֵ֖א לָ הֶ֑ם
traditions.LXX: εὑρέθη αὐτοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: et invenérunt :
traditions.KJV: and he was found of them :

15.english_reference: and the LORD gave them rest round about

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֧נַח יְהוָ֛ה לָ הֶ֖ם מִ סָּבִֽיב
traditions.LXX: κατέπαυσεν αὐτοῖς Κύριος κυκλόθεν .
traditions.VUL: præstitítque eis Dóminus réquiem per circúitum .
traditions.KJV: and the LORD gave them rest round about .

16.english_reference: And also [ concerning ] Maachah the mother of Asa the king , he removed her from [ being ] queen

traditions.WLC: וְ גַֽם מַעֲכָ֞ה אֵ֣ם אָסָ֣א הַ מֶּ֗לֶךְ הֱסִירָ הּ֙ מִ גְּבִירָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὴν Μααχὰ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ μετέστησεν τοῦ μὴ εἶναι
traditions.VUL: Sed et Máacham matrem Asa regis ex augústo depósuit império ,
traditions.KJV: And also [ concerning ] Maachah the mother of Asa the king , he removed her from [ being ] queen ,

16.english_reference: because she had made an idol in a grove

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁר עָשְׂתָ֥ה לַ אֲשֵׁרָ֖ה מִפְלָ֑צֶת
traditions.LXX: τῇ Ἀστάρτῃ λειτουργοῦσαν ,
traditions.VUL: eo quod fecísset in luco simulácrum Priápi :
